title: 3+2 under-table refusal gives heights in the tilted frame, not the value that the user typed

labels.name: effort:medium
labels.description: One module or crate, a known pattern (issue-worker-medium)

labels.name: P3
labels.description: Wrong behaviour a user hits, with a workaround; fix now

body:
## What happens

The refusal `FirstTraverseUnderTable` (#3081) gives two heights in the local frame of the 3+2 plane. The message calls them Z values. The user sets the clearance height in the user frame, so the numbers in the message are not values that the user can type.

Generate shifts each height by `h - origin.z` into the tilted frame (`crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse.rs`, `judge`). `table_read` returns `limit` as "a local height" (its doc comment), and `judge` puts `start_h` (also local) into `height_mm`. Nothing adds `origin.z` back before the message.

Example from `crates/app/tests/first_traverse_table.rs`, `a_head_tilt_past_90_under_the_table_is_refused_with_lower`:

- The tilt origin is at Z 20 (`ORIGIN_Z`). The user sets the clearance height to 170 (`ORIGIN_Z + 150.0`). The head tilts to B 120.
- The message says: "to the clearance plane at Z150.000 it can go under the table top - lower the clearance plane to Z113.590 or under it".
- In the user frame, the plane is at 170 and the limit is 133.590.

The verdict is correct and the post stays blocked. Only the numbers and the word "Z" in the text are wrong:

- With `origin.z` > 0, a user who types the given limit gets a plane that is lower than necessary.
- With `origin.z` < 0, a user who types the given limit gets the refusal again.
- The heights are measured along the tilted tool axis, not along machine Z, so "Z" is not correct for a tilted plane.

## Related

- #2991 fixes the same defect for `FirstTraverseLow` (PR #3080). That PR adds `in_user_frame` in `crates/app/src/operation/first_traverse.rs` and a `tilted` text that names the raise without a Z value.
- Found when main was merged into PR #3080. Main added `FirstTraverseUnderTable` after the review of that PR.

## Possible fix

After #3080 merges: extend `in_user_frame` to `FirstTraverseUnderTable` (add `origin.z` to `height_mm` and `limit_mm`). Change the text so that it does not call a height along the tilted axis a Z value, as #2991 does for `FirstTraverseLow`. A cache field can need `#[serde(default)]`, as `tilted` has in #3080.

## Done means

- The under-table refusal on a 3+2 plane gives the plane and the limit in the frame where the user sets the clearance height.
- The text does not call a height along a tilted tool axis a Z value.
- A test pins the two numbers in the user frame (for the case above: 170 and 133.590), and the post stays blocked.

Proposed labels (a contributor cannot set labels): `bug`, `P3`, `effort:medium`, `area:multiaxis`, `area:ui`, `source:agent`. These are the labels of #2991. The defect is a misleading refusal message with a workaround, so `P3`.
